stories.summary: McDonald’s is facing a federal lawsuit alleging that an AI tool allowed independently owned franchises to exchange non-public pricing and sales information. Prosecutors say the alleged arrangement violated antitrust law and unfairly raised menu prices for US customers.

stories.title: ‘We’re not going to go away’: the mom fighting for social media reform after her son’s suicide
stories.summary: A new documentary follows Kristin Bride’s campaign for social-media reform after her 16-year-old son died by suicide following cyberbullying. The film tracks her efforts to press Congress for change as smartphones and social platforms remain deeply embedded in daily life.
